title: The Jar That Never Ran Out
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm heart who notices who is going without, and tonight a widow shares her last meal with Elijah: Willow gives away two of her last three crackers at the park and finds there is more than enough.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Willow’s warm heart notices who is going without, and the widow shared her very last bread with a hungry prophet. In Willow’s world today: she has three crackers left at the park, and a little boy on the bench has none. Sharing feels hard. Willow gives him two anyway and smiles. Then his mom opens a big bag of orange slices for everyone. Just like the widow, Willow learned that Heavenly Father blesses people who give with a happy heart.
